event_description: A registration of generation and/or consumption plants with the grid operator reached a further step, was completed or was cancelled. Explicitly triggered by Automation; carries a full snapshot of the process and where it stands.

workflow_definition_id.description: ID of the primary workflow's definition — the most recently updated running workflow on the opportunity, which need not be the grid process. Use `workflows` to find a specific process

workflow_status.description: Status of the primary workflow. A finished or cancelled workflow only shows here while no other workflow runs on the opportunity — read completion and cancellation from `workflows`

phase_id.description: ID of the current workflow phase. Stable per workflow definition — match on this rather than the name

phase_name.description: Name of the current workflow phase as configured by the organization

task_id.description: ID of the current workflow task

task_name.description: Name of the current workflow task

opportunity_status.description: Status of the opportunity: `open`, `in_progress`, `closed`, `cancelled`, or an organization-specific value its workflow writes (e.g. the current phase name)

definition_id.description: ID of the workflow definition. Stable per blueprint and organization — identify the grid process by this

status.description: Status of the workflow, e.g. `STARTED` while running, `DONE` once completed, `CLOSED` once cancelled

phase_id.description: ID of the current workflow phase. Stable per workflow definition — match on this rather than the name

phase_name.description: Name of the current workflow phase as configured by the organization

task_id.description: ID of the current workflow task

task_name.description: Name of the current workflow task

workflows.description: Every workflow on the opportunity, running or finished, in no particular order. Identify the grid process by `definition_id`; its `status` turns `DONE` on completion and `CLOSED` on cancellation. Empty when the opportunity has no workflow

json_schema.description: Where the process stands when the event fires: every workflow on the opportunity (`workflows`, with status, current phase and task), the primary workflow mirrored at the top level, and the opportunity status. Read completion and cancellation of a specific process from its entry in `workflows`.

stage.graph_source:
{
  "workflow_definition_id": opportunity.workflows.primary.definition_id,
  "workflow_status": opportunity.workflows.primary.status,
  "phase_id": opportunity.workflows.primary.phase_id,
  "phase_name": opportunity.workflows.primary.phase_name,
  "task_id": opportunity.workflows.primary.task_id,
  "task_name": opportunity.workflows.primary.task_name,
  "opportunity_status": opportunity.status,
  "workflows": [$sift(opportunity.workflows, function($v, $k) { $k != "primary" }).*.{
    "definition_id": definition_id,
    "name": name,
    "status": status,
    "phase_id": phase_id,
    "phase_name": phase_name,
    "task_id": task_id,
    "task_name": task_name,
    "last_update_time": last_update_time
  }]
}

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf)

s3ref.description: S3 reference for the file content

version_index.description: Latest version index of the file (versions[].length - 1, or 0 if no versions array)

_tags.description: Tags on the file entity (semantic labels set by uploader/automation)

relation_tags.description: Tags on the relation pointing at the file (journey upload block tags such as "Lageplan", plus a hidden journey step marker)

_created_at.description: When the file entity was created — useful for time-window filtering

json_schema.description: Every file related to the opportunity — the documents uploaded by the start journey and every follow-up journey. Empty when the process carries none. Consumers identify a given upload via `relation_tags` (the journey upload block tags) / `_tags`.

event_attachments.graph_source: [opportunity_files.{"entity_id": _id, "filename": filename, "mime_type": mime_type, "size_bytes": size_bytes, "s3ref": s3ref, "version_index": ($count(versions) > 0 ? $count(versions) - 1 : 0), "readable_size": readable_size, "_tags": _tags, "relation_tags": relation_tags, "category": category, "file_date": file_date, "_created_at": _created_at}]
